description: A shell script for managing release processes in the Apache Spark project, including version parsing, tagging, user prompts, and environment setup.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Prompts the user for input with a default value, ensuring a value is provided.

methods.name: parse_version
methods.description: Extracts the version string from a pom.xml file.

methods.name: run_silent
methods.description: Runs a command silently, logging output and handling errors.

methods.name: fcreate_secure
methods.description: Creates a secure file with restricted permissions.

methods.name: check_for_tag
methods.description: Checks if a specific git tag exists in the repository.

methods.name: get_release_info
methods.description: Gathers and confirms release information, including versioning and tagging details.

methods.name: is_dry_run
methods.description: Checks if the script is running in dry-run mode.

methods.name: init_java
methods.description: Initializes Java version info from JAVA_HOME.

methods.name: init_maven_sbt
methods.description: Sets up Maven and SBT options based on Java version.
